tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Which payment or stablecoin providers support this asset, chain, country or service? Free: search payment and stablecoin providers by category, asset, chain, ramp country or service. Returns compact cards (no citations); use get_provider for the full cited record. 50 calls/day per client.

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: What exactly does this provider support, where is it licensed and what does it charge? Paid ($0.01 USDC): Full cited record for one provider: stablecoin rails, corridors, licences, published fees, coverage, developer and agent-payment support. Every fact has source URL, retrieval date, quote and con

tools.name: stablecoin_rails
tools.description: Who can on-ramp, off-ramp, issue or settle this stablecoin, on which chain, in which country? Paid ($0.01 USDC): Stablecoin rails by asset, chain, country and service, with the cited stablecoin block for each matching provider (assets, chains, ramp countries, fiat rails, custody model). Country matc

tools.name: find_corridor
tools.description: Who can move money from this currency or stablecoin to that one, in this country, over which rails? Paid ($0.03 USDC): Money-movement routes from one currency or stablecoin to another: corridors providers publish (rails, speed, fee notes, cited), plus on/off-ramp routes inferred from ramp coverage,

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_provider · Private data: search_providers, get_provider, stablecoin_rails, find_corridor · Public sink: find_corridor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_provider · Private data: search_providers, get_provider, stablecoin_rails, find_corridor · Public sink: find_corridor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
